concerns.text: The plan states it will “obtain a publicly available joint dataset of SMILES + FQY values” but does not cite a verified, reachable source (no URL or accession ID). The accompanying research.md notes that no verified open joint dataset exists, creating a resource feasibility gap that prevents the pipeline from being runnable.

Research.md lists the joint SMILES‑FQY requirement as “None (no verified open source)” yet the plan proceeds as if such a dataset is available, leading to an inconsistency between the data‑resource assumption and the actual verified resources.
